# mywienerlinien — llms.txt

Vienna public-transport app: live map + departures (FastAPI) + MCP server (FastMCP) for Claude Desktop.
Data: Wiener Linien OGD GTFS (PostgreSQL/PostGIS) + OGD realtime (incidents/blockages only — no live GPS;
vehicle markers are schedule-interpolated).

Full tool/endpoint/config reference: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)
Install: [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) — Changelog: [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)
